  - If no RESULT lines exist yet (first iteration), set thresholds that represent a 5-10% improvement over the current metrics (e.g. 5-10% lower for latency, 5-10% higher for scores)

pub fn adaptive_sort<T: Ord>(arr: &mut [T]) {
    let n = arr.len();
    if n < 2 { return; }
    // Detect if already sorted or reverse sorted
    let mut asc = true;
    let mut desc = true;
    for i in 1..n {
        if arr[i - 1] > arr[i] { asc = false; }
        if arr[i - 1] < arr[i] { desc = false; }
    }
    if asc { return; }
    if desc { arr.reverse(); return; }
